credential_policy: Use official local credential stores, browser sessions, connectors, or approved secret mechanisms only. Never export, log, commit, copy, or reconstruct credentials.
continuity_sources: private Git repository code and commit history
GitHub Actions run records and non-secret artifacts
existing reusable scripts under the Reels workspace

terminal_history_policy.reason: Raw shell history and full terminal captures may contain secrets or personal data.
terminal_history_policy.replacement: Preserve a sanitized index of reusable scripts, command categories, validation results, and artifact references.

services.automation_role: Supported Google AI command-line route for approved automation tasks.
services.auth_storage: Official local credential store; not exported.
services.verification_scope: Authenticated read-only agent listing when an interactive task runs.
services.fallback: Record the actual provider error; do not bypass authentication or provider restrictions.

services.automation_role: Browser-authenticated coding-agent workspace for user-visible repository work.
services.verification_scope: Authenticated workspace availability in a browser session.
services.fallback: Open the official sign-in page and request user takeover only when Google requires credentials or verification.

services.auth_storage: Official local credential store; not exported.
services.known_blocker: Provider reports the individual Code Assist route as unsupported; use the supported Anti-gravity route instead.
services.fallback: Do not retry passwords, recovery, MFA, or bypass methods for a provider-side unsupported client route.

services.automation_role: Private repository synchronization, Actions run inspection, and authorized workflow dispatch.
services.auth_storage: Official GitHub CLI credential store; not exported.
services.fallback: Record permission errors and use approved repository policy; do not bypass restrictions.

services.auth_storage: Official local credential store; not exported.
services.verification_scope: Command availability and authorized Drive operations when needed.
services.fallback: Record provider errors and request user sign-in only through official Google flows.

non_negotiable_guards: Never export or commit secrets, sessions, cookies, passwords, tokens, or API keys.
Never bypass login, MFA, CAPTCHA, repository policy, provider tier, or platform restrictions.
Never mass-publish or upload incomplete Reel segments.
Record actual failures and provider blockers accurately.
